cash_entries_direction.name: cash_entries_direction
cash_entries_direction.value: ("cash_entries"."direction" is not null) = ("cash_entries"."type" = 'adjustment' or ("cash_entries"."type" = 'transfer' and "cash_entries"."to_wallet_id" is null))

wallets_card_days.name: wallets_card_days
wallets_card_days.value: coalesce("wallets"."statement_day", 1) between 1 and 31 and coalesce("wallets"."due_day", 1) between 1 and 31 and coalesce("wallets"."credit_limit", 0) >= 0
